newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tax bureau asks for charges against oil dealer.
newsitem.headline: Tax bureau asks for charges against oil dealer.

text.p: The Osaka Taxation Bureau has asked prosecutors to press tax evasion charges against a Osaka petroleum dealer to whom Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd is alleged to have funnelled a total of 3.4 billion yen, sources close to the tax bureau said on Thursday.
The oil dealer is suspected of evading 320 million yen in taxes by not reporting incomes totalling 660 million yen from 1992 to 1994, the sources said.
Mitsubishi Oil has persistently denied funnelling money to the oil dealer.
Repeating the denial, a Mitsubishi Oil spokesman said the transactions were part of the company's usual business operations. He declined to disclose details.
The alleged funnelling of money was revealed this month in a court affidavit filed in a legal dispute between Mitsubishi Oil and Mitsui Mining Co.
In the affidavit, Mitsui said Mitsubishi Oil had asked it to cooperate in a series of oil deals in which Mitsui provided money to the oil dealer.
